RESOLVED - recommend closing. Both halves are now addressed.

Receipt half (Epic 4): compiler.R now reads normalizer/transform/reducer from task$, lowering from task$lowering, order from plan$task$stages$order, plus metric_schedule, bridge and tiles from the plan - previously all literals. Execution runs plan_geometry -> .compile_geometry_execution_plan -> .execute_geometry_plan. Verified pass 11: geometry(plan) == geometry(rel, at, over) to 0 with identical plan ids, geometry(plan, at=at) refused, evaluate_geometry accepts the same plan.

Sequencing half (Epic 0A): closed, and the subtraction matches the recommended inventory exactly - the five unreachable normalizer/transform exports removed, the three live ones kept, .evaluate_edge_operation gone. The unfalsifiability concern is now moot in the direction it was resolved: the calculus was deleted rather than wired, so there is no second lowering value to test against, and Epic 4 correctly does not carry dead normalizer/transform fields as user-settable inputs.

Suite after both: 1617 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn.

One follow-on filed separately as bd-01KZXJMDRC6VKYX6SA38R0AAH1 - Epic 0A produced no subtraction receipt and the deleted code was never committed.
